name: check_ecosystem_gitignores
description: Audit .gitignore rules across every Bodai ecosystem repo so blanket .claude/ ignores never hide the agent catalog.
author: mahavishnu

hooks.name: check_ecosystem_gitignores
hooks.description: Walk every Bodai ecosystem repo's .gitignore and verify .claude/ rules match the repo's classification (catalog vs runtime). Exits non-zero on any FAIL.
